theThreeQuestionGate.whatExecutes: spineZoningDistrict.resolveSpineZoningWhenGisAbsent, called by routes/brokeragePlaceBuildableEnvelope.ts when the live GIS parcel property carries no zoningCode; its district flows into the route's effectiveZoningCode. Before this change its sources were the baked Tier-1 snapshot and the atom chain only; now the parcel-record rail is consulted first through loadZoningFactForServe.
theThreeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: Only a blank GIS zoningCode triggers it. If GIS already carries a district, no spine read happens at all - unchanged by this PR.
theThreeQuestionGate.whatFailsOnDisagreement: Before: the route declined no-zoning-stamp while the card served a district, and nothing surfaced the disagreement except a per-parcel probe comparison. After: both surfaces read the same record cell, so a residual disagreement means one side is not reading the record rail - a named, measurable state rather than a silent one.
theThreeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: The bake bypasses the record as a separate per-county stamp (the record now wins, matching the card); any surface drawing from its own source rather than the slate-gated reader bypasses the ledger.

missionPremise: OPS-24 law and the 2026-09-11 serving-path decision (_decisions/2026-09-11_ledger_as_serving_path_seven_steps.md, ADR-031 amendment, OPS-23 section 0): the ledger is the serving path, atoms are canonical, and every surface consumes one gated reader. The lane's premise is that when a drawing route and a card disagree about a parcel's district, the route is reading an older or narrower source than the ledger the card serves.
completionPredicate: The five measured no-zoning-stamp parcels draw on the deployed surface after the change, having declined before it, verified by `node --use-system-ca scripts/surface-probe.mjs --rows P-254`; and a parcel with no district on any source still declines with its own reason. A stranger can evaluate this by running the probe and reading the five parcels' draw blocks.
scopeBasis: Scope was drawn at the route's ZONING READ because the measured dominant class (5 of the 7 named failures) had one cause there, and the dispatch's constraint kept the lane to the route's zoning read and parcel match. Kyle's geometry-clip throw and Caldwell's address-to-parcel 404 were excluded because they are different subsystems with different owners, and the prose-contradiction class because it is a different surface. The route file itself was deliberately not edited to avoid colliding with P-340 and P-339, which run in parallel on the same route.
constraintsHonored: FAN-DEPTH 0 and subAgents 0: no sub-agents launched at any depth.
